title: Senior Software Engineer - Australia
description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be designing and implementing features in one of our engineering groups:

- Digitisation: generate digital twins from various data sources using a mix of machine learning, algorithms and work on tooling to correct bad extractions as fast as possible.

- Platform: provide the API surface for organisations to extract the most value out of the data hosted on the Neara platform. Work on our internal expression language and work with customers and other teams to identify the abstractions we need to provide.

- Design: take digital twins (or prospective designs) and analyse the viability of designs, from load analysis on infrastructure to identifying the resilience of the electric network to extreme weather events.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Digitisation

- Develop and measure algorithmic/ML improvements to digital twin extraction.

- Improve monitoring to identify when our systems do a bad job of digital twin extraction (for example, distribution drift, misconfiguration).

- Develop tooling to quickly fix problems created by automated solutions.

- If you’d like to apply for a Machine Learning Engineer role in this group, please click here .

Platform

- Develop the functionality of our internal platform by identifying common abstractions that can apply to many unique use cases.

- Data abstractions that allow users to semantically model and interact with their organisation's data.

Design

- Develop solutions that provide designers the ability to simulate the structural forces on the network and the behaviour of the network in various weather scenarios.

- Develop CAD-like tooling to import engineering designs to develop networks or work with Digitisation to fit lidar and imagery to engineering designs in order to achieve better simulations.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary & meaningful ESOP

- Fully flexible working arrangements with a well-stocked office in Redfern

- Regular office events

- The real benefit is working on a genuinely complex, innovative and industry-leading product, making a genuine difference in the world around us.

To apply, please use the online application link below. Neara values diversity, belonging and equal employment opportunities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that you will require current and unrestricted working rights to be considered for the role. Unfortunately, we are not in a position to offer visa sponsorship at this time.

No agencies or third-party service providers, please.

As an Implementation Engineer (Transmission Line & Structural Design) , you'll join a growing team in India supporting our delivery and pre-sales functions, working closely with our product, sales, and development teams in Australia and the US.
This is a hybrid role on our deployment and customer success track: customer-facing, but technically deep.
Your core strength is overhead transmission line design, and you are comfortable with the structural side of it, including towers, poles, and the loads they carry. You'll bring that background to Neara, where your day-to-day involves helping clients rapidly build and compare transmission line designs on our platform. That means ingesting their data and constraints, spotting structures, evaluating multiple route/design options, and watching cost, loads, and clearance metrics update in real time.
Your design experience is what lets you do this credibly: speaking the client's language, understanding how they design lines today with legacy tools like PLS-CADD, and building their confidence in Neara's outputs. When transmission demand is lighter, you'll contribute to our core India delivery, covering model build, QA, and other US client projects (including GIS and LiDAR work).
Note: You won't be hired to deliver PLS-CADD projects as a service. That experience is highly valued so you can understand how clients work today, compare their designs with Neara critically, and speak their language. The day-to-day focus is strictly on Neara.

Some of the Things You Will Contribute To (Not All at Once)

- Design Optimization: Building and iterating transmission line designs in Neara for clients by ingesting their layers and constraints, spotting structures, and rapidly evaluating/comparing route and design options against live cost, loads, and clearance metrics.

- Data Integration: Translating customers' transmission designs (tower libraries, structure lists, plan-and-profile sheets, foundation drawings) into Neara projects.

- Structural Mapping: Mapping structural concepts (wind span, weight span, line angles, load cases, clearances, tension vs. suspension structures, foundations) into how Neara represents and calculates them.

- Workflow Migration: Helping customers compare Neara's outputs with their current PLS-CADD / PLS-TOWER workflows, and proposing practical migration paths.

- Client Engagement: Joining pre-sales demos and deployment sessions with Indian clients, fielding structural and tower-design questions, and building trust in Neara's outputs.

- Technical Ownership: Owning "what structures make sense" when colleagues configure routes and constraints, alongside doing a fair share of the GIS/spatial work yourself.

- Value & Efficiency: Independently conducting basic ROI calculations: measuring the time and cost of customers' existing workflows and understanding/measuring what efficiencies Neara solutions generate.

- Core Delivery Support: Contributing to core India delivery (model build, QA, GIS / LiDAR work) when transmission demand is lighter, and partnering with engineering and product to improve project speed.

You Will Need to Have

- Education: A degree in Structural or Mechanical Engineering, with clear exposure to overhead transmission line design.

- Experience: Around 3 to 5 years working on overhead transmission line (OHTL / OHL) projects, focused on transmission line routing, structural load analysis, and tower spotting optimization.

- Domain Knowledge: A solid grasp of tower behavior, covering load cases (wind, weight, temperature, and ice in snow regions), how line angles drive tension vs. suspension structures, clearances, and basic foundation concepts.

- Technical Skills: Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, tower/foundation details, specifications, and geotechnical inputs, including working knowledge of AutoCAD.

- Communication: Fluent verbal and written English communication skills and real comfort with customers, allowing you to ask good questions and explain trade-offs simply to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Flexibility: Willingness to work a hybrid role across time zones (India, US, Australia), with some client-site travel for workshops, demos, and deployment.

What it means to be in Strategy & Operations at Neara
At Neara, Strategy & Operations work on making sure our top strategic priorities are executed. When we do it well, the signal is unmistakable:

- A new vertical goes from idea to its first delivered customer project, with the processes, GTM motion and operating structure built as it goes.

- A stalled, high-stakes customer project gets de-risked and back on track.

- An account team finds the cross-sell and expansion value sitting behind a customer it already has.

You figure out where to help, and drive those outcomes.
Every quarter, we step back and ask: what has to happen for Neara to achieve it's goals? Then we go and help make it happen. That might mean pairing with an exec or our c-suite on a critical initiative, laying the groundwork and temporarily acting as a new role the business needs, working with Sales and CS to get more value out of every customer, or reviewing and rebuilding a process that's slowing teams down.
A note on what this role isn't: this isn't a classic strategy role. You won't spend much time on market maps, partnerships, M&A or slides. You'll be hands-on, embedded with teams and shipping real outcomes, often with some code, data or product work along the way. If you'd rather be in the room building the thing than presenting on it, read on.
We're hiring for Strategy & Operations roles in Sydney, Australia across two tracks: Generalist and AI & Engineering . We're open to hiring at a range of levels, from Associate through to more senior roles, depending on your experience. Great candidates share the same fundamentals, and the track reflects where your experience runs deepest.

What You'll Do

- Help the most important things go right: Each quarter, work with leadership to find the initiatives that matter most for Neara's trajectory, then embed with the teams delivering them.

- Execute high-impact internal projects: Run projects across functions that deliver immediate and long term strategic and operational value, from diagnosis through to implementation.

- Drive execution and transparency: Structure, track and unblock major cross-functional initiatives so milestones land and leadership has a clear view of progress towards our biggest strategic priorities.

- Unlock customer value: Partner with Sales and CS to de-risk strategically important projects, quantify the value behind every customer, and open up cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

- Build new verticals: Work with technical and commercial teams to stand up the operating structures, GTM motion and processes for new business lines, including helping deliver the first projects.

- Gap-fill and pivot quickly: Embed temporarily wherever the business has a critical need or to help reach our north star goals, most often in Product, Engineering or Customer Success.

What You'll Bring

- Relevant experience: Typically 3+ years in operations or strategy at a high-growth startup, in consulting, or in a technical or product role, ideally with a bias toward execution. We'll calibrate the level to your background. Bonus points for enterprise SaaS or energy/utilities experience.

- Strong analytical ability: You turn raw data into clear structure, sound logic and decisions people can act on.

- Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity: You pick up new concepts, industries and technical contexts quickly, and you create momentum without waiting for the perfect brief.

- Credibility across the business: Excellent written and verbal communication, and you're as effective with engineers as you are with commercial leads and execs.

- A "dirt-under-the-fingernails" mindset: Practical and low-ego, and as excited about operational execution as you are about shaping team strategy.

- Hands-on technical foundations: Some experience with coding, product or engineering. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be comfortable getting technical.

Two Tracks, One Standard
Tell us which track fits. We assess the fundamentals first and specialisation second.
AI & Engineering
Embedding with our AI and engineering teams to accelerate delivery and adoption
You're most at home close to the technical work: working with data, understanding how models and pipelines behave, and helping AI and engineering teams turn capability into customer and business impact. You can hold your own in technical conversations and roll up your sleeves on the data yourself.
Ideal background: data science or data engineering, with experience working alongside AI or engineering teams.
Generalist
Moving across the business to solve whatever matters most right now
You thrive on variety. One quarter you're de-risking a major customer project, the next you're redesigning a process or building out a new vertical. You bring structure to messy problems and follow them through to execution.
Ideal background: startup operations, consulting with a strong execution bent, or a product or technical role, plus enough technical fluency to work credibly with technical teams.
